g.text: OXPHOS and complex I pass BH FDR < 0.05; cristae and mTORC1 are contextual
U1: upstream context; D1-D3: minimum downstream steps
D3 paths to all 8 observed query hits
Display threshold >=3/12 is a coverage choice, not a significance cutoff
All model edges among displayed nodes are retained
Thick black border: mitochondrial query hit at >=3/12
Node size and x/12 show neighborhood recurrence
U1 is upstream context; D1-D3 nodes lie downstream; arrows follow the Bayesian-network direction
